root_cause_label: Environment Crash Due to Resource Constraints Post-Compilation
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly modified the kernel source and built bzImage, but the container runtime crashed from resource exhaustion at the final step before the agent could create an initramfs and run QEMU.
t_err_evidence: Step 23 read of /app/linux-6.9/usr/gen_init_cpio returns: 'The action has not been executed due to a runtime error. The runtime system may have crashed and restarted due to resource constraints.' This is the first and only failure point; the agent made no reasoning error prior to this crash.
t_commit_evidence: The container OOM crash at step 23 is simultaneously the decisive mistake and the lock-in point; the agent could not continue after the runtime crash, and no QEMU execution was possible.
t_surface_evidence: Step 23 terminal output explicitly reports 'runtime system may have crashed and restarted due to resource constraints', which is the first visible failure signal.
trigger_explanation: The container hosting the build environment ran out of resources (likely memory) after completing a full Linux kernel compilation. The agent encountered a genuine external environment obstacle (OOM crash) at step 23; there was no model reasoning error. The agent did not handle this crash (the session ended), but there was nothing to handle as the runtime itself became unavailable.
